::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Southern China's first 12-inch foundry fab, a UMC joint-venture entity branded United Semiconductor; began volume production in 2016.
:::

**Chinese name:** 联芯集成电路制造（厦门）有限公司 (Liánxīn Jíchéng Diànlù Zhìzào (Xiàmén) Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers at mature/legacy process nodes for foundry customers.

## Why does it matter?

A second Taiwanese foundry major (alongside TSMC) with an operating mainland China fab, reinforcing that cross-strait manufacturing links persist in mature-node foundry work even as the leading-edge relationship (TSMC's most advanced nodes, UMC's own frontier R&D) stays firmly based in Taiwan.
